title: 1:1 playbook — Maya Chen (direct report) — Apr 21 2026
content:
Context: quick weekly 1:1 with Maya (IC - backend inference). Focus: unblock her on the latency regression work, career coaching (next steps toward senior+), and check on on-call fatigue after last week's incidents. Keep this tight (30m).

Goals for this meeting:
- Surface any hidden blockers on the latency/regression effort (ENG-4321)
- Decide whether to escalate the rolling fallback policy for the 2pm traffic window
- Career conversation: what stretch project would be motivating (lead a small perf spike playbook?)
- Capture 2 concrete action items and a 1-wk follow-up

Proposed agenda (30m):
1) Quick pulse / personal (3-5m)
   - How are you feeling after last week's on-call? energy level, anything I should know?
2) Blockers & status (8-10m)
   - Latency regression triage (ENG-4321): where are we on root cause? who needs help?
   - PR #987 (kv-cache change) merge risks and rollout plan
3) Priorities check (5m)
   - What needs to be deprioritized to ship the regression fix this week?
4) Career / growth (7m)
   - Short-term goal review (ownership of perf playbook, mentor pairing)
   - Ask: interested in leading a 2-week spike to prototype adaptive routing?
5) Wrap + actions (2-3m)

Key questions to ask Maya (quick prompts):
- On a scale 1-5, how stressed do you feel about the on-call load? What would reduce that by 1 point?
- If you could own one cross-team project this quarter, what would it be?
- Do you have feedback for me about the way I prioritize work or unblock you?

Notes from last 1:1 (Apr 14) - follow-ups status:
- Action: Maya to submit initial kv-cache experiment results -> DONE, notes in PR #987 thread
- Action: I to loop in Samir for infra quota for dedicated repro -> IN PROGRESS (Samir said waiting on finance approval)
- Action: schedule peer pairing with Lina for micro-batching review -> SCHEDULED (Thu 4/22)

Quick telemetry snippets to pull before meeting (one-liners):
- 95th token latency for hosted-api route "chat/short": +18% week-over-week (source: console/latency-dashboard)
- Error spike correlating with cache warmup window between 13:56-14:12 PDT on 2026-04-19 (incident notes)
- Recent deploys: serving-runtime v2.3.4 -> candidate that changed kv-cache eviction policy

Possible hypotheses for regression (to surface quickly):
- Eviction policy changed warming behavior -> cold cache penalty on tail requests
- New kernel selection path for int8 causing longer startup jitter on first utterance
- Batch sizing heuristic not matching short-chat distribution -> batching latency increase

What I can bring to the table (offers to unblock):
- Pull Samir into the call with Maya for infra quota / capacity decisions
- Re-prioritize non-critical grooming to free Maya 2 days to run deeper experiments
- Offer to own cross-team comms if we need an immediate rollback/escalation

Desired outcomes & acceptance criteria by EOD Friday 2026-04-24:
- Repro steps documented and minimal repro created for latency spike (Maya)
- If root cause is cache-warmup, plan for graceful backoff and staged rollout created (owner + schedule)
- Career: Maya to outline a 2-sprint plan for leading the perf playbook (bullet list)

Action items (captured as quick checklist):
- [ ] Maya: push minimal repro and add runbook notes to ENG-4321 — due 2026-04-23
- [ ] Jordan (me): ping Samir about expedited infra quota decision and tag in ENG-4321 — due 2026-04-21 EOD
- [ ] Maya: draft 2-sprint perf playbook outline and share with me — due 2026-04-28
- [ ] Jordan: block 4 hours on Maya's calendar next week for uninterrupted experiments (Thu) — due 2026-04-22

Open questions / to chase after meeting:
- Should we enable the older kv-cache eviction strategy as a temporary rollback? (ops cost vs. risk)
- Do we need formal post-incident follow-up (PIR) given multiple customer-facing errors?

Notes for follow-up message to Maya after the 1:1 (template):
"Thanks for today — appreciate the quick triage. I'll escalate the quota with Samir and will block time on Thu for your experiments. Please drop the repro in ENG-4321 and ping me when ready. Let's sync Friday for a short 15m status check if anything changes."

Random scratch / prompts I might refer to live:
- Ask about recent review: "Were the comments on PR #987 actionable? any pushback from infra?"
- Temperature check: "What part of the regression work feels most ambiguous?"

Mental model reminders (for me):
- Keep the meeting action-oriented; defer deep technical debugging to the blocked 4-hour session
- Be explicit about tradeoffs (rollback vs. staged fix) and call for decision if we hit the 24-hour rule
- Use this as opportunity to surface leadership readiness if Maya is interested in taking on cross-team stretch work

End of doc.
